source_note: 一致几乎处处有界函数列算术平均值几乎处处收敛的问题
english_source_note: A.e. Convergence of Cesaro Means of Uniformly a.e. Bounded Functions
callout_id: 一致几乎处处有界函数列算术平均值几乎处处收敛的问题#5
statement_en:
There exists a positive real number $M$ such that
$$|A_{n+1}(x)-A_n(x)|\leq \frac{2M}{n+1}$$
almost everywhere.
callout_body: 存在正实数$M$使得$$|A_{n+1}(x)-A_n(x)|\leq \frac{2M}{n+1}$$几乎处处成立。
